description: This PHP source file defines the RSSDashlet class, a customizable dashboard widget for displaying RSS feeds within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for rendering the dashlet, configuring options, and parsing RSS XML data.

classes.name: RSSDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying RSS feeds, configurable with URL, height, and auto-refresh options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with optional configuration parameters, loads language strings, and sets default properties.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet HTML, including RSS feed output.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the dashlet, allowing URL, height, and auto-refresh settings.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Filters and saves user-submitted configuration options.

methods.name: getRSSOutput
methods.description: Fetches and parses the RSS feed from the specified URL, returning HTML table of feed items or error message.
